skills.name: Basic Attack: Full Firepower
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Unleashes a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold to enter Crouching Shot to extend the attack duration.
Drag the stick/joystick during Crouching Shot to launch Rolling Shot and adjust the character's position, dealing Physical DMG.
Stop pressing or holding during Crouching Shot to launch Finishing Shot at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge: Risky Business
skills.desc:
Press  to dodge:
A rapid dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Starlight Sanction
skills.desc:
When dragging the joystick during a dodge, press :
Launches a piercing attack at nearby enemies within a large area, dealing Physical DMG.
When not dragging the joystick during a dodge, press :
Launches a piercing attack at enemies in a line, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Fair Fight
skills.desc:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealinng Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Power of Teamwork
skills.desc:
Assist
Quick Assist
When the on-filed character is launched, press  to activate:
Launches a piecing attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

skills.name: Evasive Assist: Flash Spin
skills.desc:
Assist
Evasive Assist
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Fatal Shot
skills.desc:
Assist
Assist Follow-Up
Press  after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Pierces enemies in a large area in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Stand Still
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Performs up to 3 piercing attacks in a line, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Clearance Time
skills.desc:
With enough energy, press  to activate:
Launches a powerful piercing attack in a line, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Starlight Mirage
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful piercing attack at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Starlight, Shine Bright
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Unleashes a powerful piercing attack at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill

skills.name: Core Passive: Steady Shot
skills.desc: Billy's DMG increases by X% when he enters Crouching Shot during his Basic Attack. The effect ends if he moves, returns to standby, or is knocked back or launched by an attack.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Team Starlight
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
After Billy uses a Chain Attack, the DMG of his next Ultimate is increased by 50%, stacking up to 2 times. This effect resets whenever an ultimate is activated

cons.name: Dazzling Entrance
cons.desc: When Billy hits an enemy with a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.

cons.name: Roaming Gunslinger
cons.desc:
Billy's Dodge Counter DMG increases by 25%.
Rolling Shots during his Basic Attacks are treated as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during the skill and able to trigger Perfect Dodges.
When a Rolling Shot triggers a Perfect Dodge, it will automatically become a Dodge Counter.

cons.name: Teachings of the Starlight Knights
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Starlight Ballistics
cons.desc: When Billy hits an enemy with his EX Special Attack, the skill's CRIT Rate is increased based on the distance from the enemy. The closer he is to the target, the greater the effect, up to a maximum increase of 32%.

cons.name: Lost Technological Constructs
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Starlight Hero
cons.desc: When Billy accumulates 10 hits on enemies or triggers a Perfect Dodge, his DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times and lasting until he's knocked back or launched by an attack.
